analysis.support_validation: compression_jpeg:1 reproduces all 5 support pairs byte-identically (md5 equal, MSE=0, PSNR=inf, CI 10/10). No candidate can improve on an exact match; counterfactuals are strictly worse (jpeg:2 = 29.07 dB; blur_gaussian:1+jpeg:1 = 28.10 dB; noise YCrCb/RGB pre-JPEG candidates fail sigma signal match at 33-200% error).
analysis.rationale: Single effective deterministic JPEG step at PIL quality 25 (severity 1). Step1: block_boundary 1.2117-1.7329 and dct_zero_ratio 0.4815-0.8731 on all 5 pairs (0% FP signal). Exact md5 reproduction across 5 independent images fixes the severity at 1 (sev2 = 29.07 dB, sev3 = 26.51 dB). No blur: spectral_slope_ratio 0.9966-1.0023 (<1.08) on every pair despite gm_ratio dips (pair1 0.7102) caused by JPEG edge reconstruction. No global: variance_ratio 0.9437-0.9993, mean_shift <=0.6/255, spread_ratio 0.9852-1.0031, chroma 0.919-0.999; pair3 heavy clipping (0.0662) is content-inherent (clean 0.0478, delta +0.0183). No noise: per-pair sigma estimates vary 0.37-4.32 for the same pipeline (0.37/0.62/1.11/2.22/4.32) which is JPEG-artifact driven; peeled residual after jpeg:1 is identically zero (std=0.0) on pairs 0 and 3, and residual_intensity_corr sign flips across pairs (-0.287/+0.077/+0.324/+0.110/-0.095), excluding gamma/noise. R0 support_psnr=30.35 is therefore a model capacity/training outcome, not a blind-ID error.
